reactBaseline: React 19.3.0 + React Compiler; each row uses useSyncExternalStore against a per-row selector subscription; one React click notifies the selected rows and lets React batch their updates.
runtimeStrategy: OXC-emitted state-site graph selects the changed owner site; the scheduler coalesces writes and commits all selected stable keyed host regions in one validated partial-commit batch.
limitations: One Chrome profile/device and one flat 10,000-row DOM tree.
Programmatic click events; mount is reported separately; layout, paint, and display presentation are excluded.
Fanout is limited to independent boolean leaves with stable keyed host roots; structural edits, nested dirty owners, and lifecycle churn are outside this study.
The React arm uses per-row external-store selectors and the React Compiler, not application-specific memoized context or a custom selector library.
